messages.text: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

In the R&D stage, the signaling tester role is to emulate a real network / WLAN link and test the wireless device in signaling mode under real-world conditions, including RF TX/RX characteristics for Wi‑Fi 7 [2].  
For Wi‑Fi 7, this matters because MLO is a key feature and multiple RF chains are important in the test environment [2].  
Wi‑Fi 7 signaling tests cited include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and end-to-end test capabilities [2].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, the CMX500 signaling-mode workflow is described as validating prototype Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn WLAN device physical-layer features [26].  
Wi‑Fi 8 signaling tests focus on features such as distributed resource units, unequal modulation, and broader signaling-mode performance analysis [27].
In the production stage, the non-signaling tester role is to run fast RF measurements without a live signaling connection, because WLAN production RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time [1].  
For Wi‑Fi 7 production, the CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this non-signaling RF test purpose and supports Wi‑Fi 7 among other technologies [1].  
The CMP180 production setup can support 2x2 MIMO in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [1].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, the CMP180 relation is limited to a demonstrated 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn waveform candidate, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [1].

answer.question: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow? Explain the role in the workflow and how it relates to Wi-Fi 7/8 testing.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests
[[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode 測試能力，用於驗證 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] WLAN device 的 physical layer features。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要
- 來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter `created: 2026-09-11`，本文 ingest 日期為 2026-09-15。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。

- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的焦點被描述為從 sheer speed 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）performance。
- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。
- 來源列出 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的新 testing hurdles，包括 [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）與 [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）。
- dRU measurements 被描述為可驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Bluetest Flow › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMX500 OBT 的關係
[[Bluetest Flow]] 在來源中扮演測試環境控制軟體：

- 控制 / 操作 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）。
- 依前一份來源，整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] signaling / test functionality。
- 依新來源，[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 整合 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality。
- 支援 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]，並在新來源中擴展為 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 的 multi-technology workflow。

Bluetest Flow › 來源中的定位
- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[Bluetest Flow]] 描述為 integrated test environment for complex wireless solutions。
- 同一來源說明，透過整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 WLAN developers 可 leverage [[Bluetest]] reverberation chamber technology。
- 同一來源稱此 integration 可讓 developers and manufacturers of next-generation WLAN technology 使用 [[Bluetest]] RTS 對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 進行 MIMO stress testing。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）明確標示 latest version of [[Bluetest Flow]] software 為 **v1.18**。
- 同一來源說明 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 enable developers to perform [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing using [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] within the [[Bluetest]] RTS。
- 同一來源說明 [[Bluetest]] 也 expanded earlier integrated testing capabilities for WLAN stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be），now supporting bandwidth up to 320 MHz for [[Wi-Fi 7]]。

|---|---|---|
| [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] | Flow version 未標示 | [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations and access points OTA MIMO stress testing |
| [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] | [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 | [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[LTE]]、[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be、[[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to 320 MHz |

Bluetest Flow › unresolved
- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 未標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] software version；[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 則標示 latest version 為 v1.18。
- 來源未標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。

- 來源未提供 automation API、test case list、report format、throughput / latency / MIMO stress test metric 或 measurement uncertainty。

Bluetest Flow
[[Bluetest Flow]] 是 [[Bluetest]] 的 control software / integrated test environment；Rohde & Schwarz / Bluetest 來源說明其整合 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 測試功能，用於 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）中的 OTA radio and antenna performance validation。

NTN signaling customer discovery
[[NTN signaling customer discovery]] 是用問卷方式蒐集 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] signaling 測試需求的方法，重點在把 service offering、network configuration、technology release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 deployment workflow 問清楚，而不是直接宣稱產品能力。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S WoMT 測試方案 › 測試目標與技術背景
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 project deck 描述的 WoMT 目標是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- 來源稱 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands，且全球缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的既有 test standards。
- device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP。
- 測試與標準化敘事包含 [[SGS]]、Indian Government、measurement procedures 與 formal WoMT standard proposal，但未提供正式文件。

依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]：

- 測試方案分為 full spec、RD and manufacture site、RD site、ref. spec 與 appendix。
- RD / manufacturing setup 顯示 native Wi-Fi / IB band 與 mmWave path 分工：[[R&S CMP180]] 處理 WIFI IB band，[[R&S CMP200]] 搭配 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 處理 WIFI mmWave。
- RD site setup 顯示 [[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 與 Tx / Rx measurement。

SGS › 與無線認證實驗室主題的關係
[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]將無線通訊認證實驗室的任務概括為：

- 測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準。
- 涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規及一致性認證。
- 支援 [[Global Market Access]] 與上市加速。

SGS 在此來源中是上述實驗室類型的代表列名之一。

Starlink User Terminal 測試流程 › Regulatory certification path
來源列出：

- FCC USA：Part 15 WLAN router、Part 25 NGSO satellite、SAR / MPE testing。
- Taiwan NCC：Fixed satellite service compliance、Ku-band uplink overlap review。
- Labs：[[Bureau Veritas]] Taoyuan、local R&S / Keysight partnerships for emissions。
- Key Limits：EIRP density、PFD at ground、interference mitigation、beacon power。
- Timeline：DVT cert 3–6 months、PVT production ramp post-approval。

⚠️ [[Starlink UT Test Flow]]（2026-09-18 raw converted）說 NCC/FCC certification: Taiwan labs，且 Key Takeaways 說 Taiwan labs (NCC, Bureau Veritas) critical for LEO certification path，但既有頁面 [[NCC]] 說 NCC 在衛星 / 通訊監理語境應連到 [[國家通訊傳播委員會]]，不是測試實驗室。判斷：將 NCC 視為監理 / 認證流程節點而非 lab；實驗室角色目前只由 [[Bureau Veritas]] Taoyuan 與未具名 local partnerships 支撐。

[Wi-Fi 8](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/wireless-communications-testing/wireless-standards/wlan-wi-fi/wi-fi-8-testing/wi-fi-8-testing_258504.html "Wi-Fi 8") builds upon the foundation of Wi-Fi 7, retaining core physical layer parameters like supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz and 4096QAM modulation, as well as Multi-Link-Operation (MLO). However, to achieve its UHR goals, IEEE 802.11bn introduces a suite of innovative PHY and MAC layer technologies that present new testing hurdles. At MWC 2026, visitors can experience how to address key testing challenges associated with Wi-Fi 8 with the enhanced testing capabilities of the CMX500 one-box signaling tester, one of the most versatile mobile device test platforms in the market, which supports many of the demanding features of Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 today.

In the R&D stage, the signaling tester role is to emulate a real network / WLAN link and test the wireless device in signaling mode under real-world conditions, including RF TX/RX characteristics for Wi‑Fi 7 [2].  
For Wi‑Fi 7, this matters because MLO is a key feature and multiple RF chains are important in the test environment [2].  
Wi‑Fi 7 signaling tests cited include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and end-to-end test capabilities [2].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, the CMX500 signaling-mode workflow is described as validating prototype Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn WLAN device physical-layer features [26].  
Wi‑Fi 8 signaling tests focus on features such as distributed resource units, unequal modulation, and broader signaling-mode performance analysis [27].
In the production stage, the non-signaling tester role is to run fast RF measurements without a live signaling connection, because WLAN production RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time [1].  
For Wi‑Fi 7 production, the CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this non-signaling RF test purpose and supports Wi‑Fi 7 among other technologies [1].  
The CMP180 production setup can support 2x2 MIMO in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [1].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, the CMP180 relation is limited to a demonstrated 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn waveform candidate, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [1].

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests
[[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode 測試能力，用於驗證 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] WLAN device 的 physical layer features。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |
